useables.name: Alcohol
useables.description: This is the cheap stuff. Not quite Bud Lite, but similar.
useables.longDescription: Drink a bottle of alcohol, and have the potential to gain a slight luck boost that will grant you better luck in stealing from others. However, you become more susceptible to being stolen from! There is also a 10% chance you will die from alcohol poisoning.
useables.use: it gives 15% more chance for successful reobbery but others have 15% successfull robbery chance against the user

useables.name: Ammo
useables.description: Does this ammo even fit the hunting rifle?
useables.longDescription: While this item is active, you cannot find "nothing" while hunting. Found from the professional hunter job.
useables.use: after use for 1 hour users hunt doesnt fail

useables.name: Bank Note
useables.description: Imagine if banks actually had a max amount. Wait, some do? Thanks Obama.
useables.longDescription: You can use this item to expand your max bank space.
useables.use: adds 2500 coins to the maximum bank amount

useables.name: Bottle of Whiskey
useables.description: Whiskey and a little coke, daddy likey
useables.longDescription: Using this will give you a better chance to steal from people for 15 hours. Found from the bartender job.
useables.use: it gives a better chance of successful robbery against the others (10%) for 1 hour

useables.name: Candy
useables.description: It is not saltwater taffy. Unless...
useables.longDescription: Using this item will give a small amount of coins.
useables.use: upon use it gives the user 5000 coins and adds it to the users balance

useables.name: Candy Corn
useables.description: I'm starting to think whoever developed this bot just really likes corn.
useables.longDescription: Using this item will give you a level instantly. You can use more than one at once to level in bulk!
useables.use: upon /use it gives the user 1 level

useables.name: Cupid's Big Toe
useables.description: Cupid lost this in a bet. I took it fair and square, legally of course.
useables.longDescription: Applies a multiplier of **69%** for **69 seconds**.
useables.use: it gives a 69% boost for coins that are coming from begging and crime for 69 seconds

useables.name: Pizza Slice
useables.description: You wanted pineapple chunks on this, we get it. Too bad.
useables.longDescription: Using this item will give you a 2.5x XP multi for 30 minutes.
useables.use: it gives an xp booster of 2.5x for 30 minutes
